subject: Annual Return Filing Due - STU Pvt Ltd (MCA Compliance)
message: As discussed, please file our Annual Return (MGT-7) and Financial Statements (AOC-4) with ROC by 31 October 2026. This is a compliance requirement under Companies Act 2013. Non-filing will attract a penalty of Rs. 100 per day. Please send us the draft financials for review before filing.
